scientific_question: Does normal-only musculoskeletal-radiograph MAE adaptation improve frozen reconstruction-error localization, especially for tumors below 1% image area, relative to the identical ImageNet MAE?
scientific_role: mechanism feasibility probe; not a final pseudo-mask pipeline and not a SKELEX reproduction

allowed_training_information: binary image-level normal/tumor labels used only to form the normal-only adaptation cohort

normal_adapted.cohort: all eligible clean-train normal images only
normal_adapted.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; no validation selection
normal_adapted.augmentation: black square pad; random resized crop scale 0.20-1.00; horizontal flip p=0.5

frozen_inference.score: mean RGB squared reconstruction error on masked pixels only

diagnostics.comparison: adapted minus base, paired complete-group bootstrap 10000
diagnostics.promotion_rule: No automatic promotion. Require coherent continuous-metric gain in small lesions without material overall/medium/large regression before designing a separate pseudo-mask protocol.

data_policy.validation_gt: opened only after all prediction maps and hashes are frozen
